A: Two ways: maker-checker seats vs failure wall. Maker-checker: eleven visitors never approve own appliance; each watches, then tests another's fix. Failure wall: every miss is posted by fault class and opens next session. Chosen: pick one demo by new skill per minute, then combine. Electrician fixes one kettle slowly, posts two past misses, then pairs each visitor to test someone else's kettle with different fault. Example: Saturday's burnt fuse teaches next week's frayed cord. Test: hide wall one week; if visitors fix only seen models, wall drives transfer, not watching.
B: Two ways: barrier steps vs expiring leases. Barrier: both switch loud/soft together every fifteen minutes by clock. Lease: one end holds lively lease, other stays quiet; lease expires alone, next holder takes over. Chosen: alternating fifteen-minute leases with rising set numbers; only current number may peak, older number stays soft even if player paused. Example: north lively 8:00-8:15 with set 1, south soft; south lively 8:15-8:30 with set 2. Test: compare one night leases vs one night both-loud-then-retreat; if cases show two living ends only under leases, timed yielding beats matching.
C: Two ways: tiered waitlist vs paging rotation. Tiers drop in order when night fills; rotation keeps recent voices resident plus neighbours of missed voices. Chosen: log every play in order, post nightly snapshot list, fill three hours by tiers with unplayed first, recent last, naming dropped tapes. Keep last-played set for next night and prefetch neighbours of long-unplayed tapes. Track miss rate. Example: Tuesday's log shows tape 14 skipped; snapshot posts it; Wednesday plays 14 plus neighbour 15. Test: compare one week tiers-plus-log vs one week newest-first; if quiet voices air only under tiers-plus-log, ordering plus correction wins.
D: Two ways: provenance salvage vs linked keepsakes. Salvage tags each beam with crossings it served; keepsakes split memories into small linked cards. Chosen: collect one-sentence crossing cards each season, link cards sharing place or hour, record crossing year plus telling date, close old versions without deleting. Each salvaged beam carries card cluster codes, scored by independent tellings. Example: 7:40 school-crossing stories from three decades pick one girder to set in new railing with codes stamped. Test: offer two girders, one top-linked, one staff-picked; if daily crossers recognize stories only on linked one, links beat picking.
